map.鹿特丹标准(Rotterdam 2003)：满足以下3项中≥2项即可诊断PCOS: Rotterdam criteria (2003): diagnosing PCOS requires at least 2 of the following 3 items
map.按鹿特丹标准（三项中满足两项）诊断 PCOS。: Diagnose PCOS by the Rotterdam criteria (two of three items met).
map.排除其他高雄疾病后制定方案。: Formulate the plan after excluding other causes of hyperandrogenism.
map.：稀发排卵 + 高雄激素（多毛/痤疥）+ 多囊卵巢（AFC>12 或体积增大）：: Infrequent ovulation plus hyperandrogenism (hirsutism or acne) plus polycystic ovaries (AFC>12 or increased volume): all three items met, so this is type A (classic PCOS) with the highest metabolic risk.
map.：高雄 + 多囊但排卵正常：满足 2 项，为 C 型，生育力相对较好但仍需评估代: Hyperandrogenism plus polycystic ovaries but normal ovulation: two items met, so this is type C, with relatively better fertility but metabolic assessment still needed.
map.鹿特丹标准几条？: How many items are in the Rotterdam criteria?
map.三项：①稀发/无排卵 ②临床或生化高雄 ③超声多囊卵巢；满足任意两项且排除其他病: Three items: (1) infrequent/absent ovulation, (2) clinical or biochemical hyperandrogenism, (3) polycystic ovaries on ultrasound; meeting any two and excluding other causes diagnoses PCOS.
map.高雄也见于先天性肾上腺增生、库欣、雄激素肿瘤等，需查 17-OHP、皮质醇等排除: Hyperandrogenism also appears in congenital adrenal hyperplasia, Cushing syndrome and androgen-secreting tumors, so 17-OHP and cortisol and similar tests are needed to exclude these before diagnosing PCOS.
